content.text: 18. REMOVE OUTPUT SHAFT CENTER BEARING AND FIRST GEAR ASSEMBLY

items: (a) Shift No. 1 hub sleeve onto the 2nd gear.
(b) Using a press, remove the center bearing, 1st gear, needle roller bearing, inner race and synchronizer ring.

content.description: Illustration showing a press being used to remove parts from an output shaft assembly positioned vertically. The shaft has gears and bearings that are being pressed off from the top.
Illustration showing a gear with locking ball being removed using a pointed tool or pick.

content.text: 20. REMOVE NO. 1 HUB SLEEVE ASSEMBLY, SECOND GEAR AND NEEDLE ROLLER BEARING
Using a press, remove the parts from the shaft as an assembly.

content.description: Illustration showing a press being used to remove the No. 1 hub sleeve assembly, second gear and needle roller bearing from a shaft positioned vertically.

content.text: 21. REMOVE NO. 2 HUB SLEEVE ASSEMBLY AND THIRD GEAR
(a) Using snap ring pliers, remove the snap ring.

content.description: Illustration showing snap ring pliers being used to remove a snap ring from a hub sleeve assembly.

content.text: (b) Using a press, remove No. 2 hub sleeve, synchronizer ring and 3rd gear.

content.description: Illustration showing a press being used to remove the No. 2 hub sleeve, synchronizer ring and 3rd gear from a shaft.
